en.headline: Private home prices rise for second straight month in September
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department said the official index climbed 0.19 per cent to 320.8 while rents reached a new high after 11 months of gains.
body: The Rating and Valuation Department released figures on Wednesday showing private home prices increased for a second consecutive month in September.

The official private domestic price index stood at 320.8, up 0.19 per cent from August and 9.3 per cent higher than a year earlier. Prices have risen more than 7 per cent in the first nine months of 2026.
Small and medium-sized flats recorded a 0.16 per cent monthly gain and were up 9.3 per cent year-on-year. Larger units rose 0.8 per cent on the month and 9.5 per cent annually.

The rental index reached 212.2, a new high after 11 months of increases, up 0.47 per cent month-on-month and 6.2 per cent year-on-year. Rents have climbed 5.8 per cent in the first nine months of the year.

zh.headline: 差估署指9月樓價連升兩個月 租金指數再創新高
zh.dek: 私人住宅售價指數報320.8，按月升0.19%，按年升9.3%。租金指數連升11個月至212.2。
body: 差餉物業估價署周三公布數據，本港9月私人住宅售價指數連升兩個月。
售價指數報320.8，按月升0.19%，按年升9.3%。今年首九個月樓價累計上升逾7%。
中小型單位樓價按月升0.16%，按年升9.3%；大型單位按月升0.8%，按年升9.5%。
租金指數再創新高，連升11個月，9月報212.2，按月升0.47%，按年升約6.2%。今年首九個月租金累計升5.8%。
